summary: Wide residential kerb where cars park, homes 14-20 m away.

best_section.where: Meiers Road west kerb, north of the first bend

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 14 m and 20 m on the west side, more across the road; homes all round within 25 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed road with a parking lane; cars park on both kerbs.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked along both sides; no signs on this stretch.

flags: Low-lying: min elevation 27 m so not flood-prone
sun_shade: Open kerb with a few street trees; afternoon sun from the west over the houses.
